teams.detail: Eliminated in East Semis, Game 7 loss to Cleveland. First playoff run since 2008 — franchise trending up. Off-season begins.
Beat Athletics yesterday (Game 1). Record ~26-29. Game 2 vs. A's in Sacramento tonight.
Won Super Bowl LX 29-13 over Patriots. OTAs underway at VMAC. Six primetime games on 2026 schedule; open vs. New England Sept. 9.
Purple beat Gold 27-10 in Dawgs After Dark spring game. Staff on 2027 recruiting visits this week. Season opens fall 2026.
Building 2026-27 roster — 12 of 15 spots filled. Added Wini Braga (Brazil). Duke tops early 2026-27 Power 44 rankings.

headlines.headline: Michigan wins 2026 NCAA title over UConn; Players Era 16 brackets revealed for November
headlines.detail: Wolverines dominated in the paint to claim the championship. Players Era 16 — 24 teams, two Las Vegas events — is the largest regular-season event in CBB history.

headlines.headline: Knicks reach Finals for first time since 1999; Thunder host Spurs in Game 5 tonight
headlines.detail: New York swept Cleveland in the East Finals. OKC leads San Antonio 3-1 in the West Finals; Game 5 tips at 8:30 PM ET.

headlines.headline: Aaron Rodgers confirms final season; Stafford signs $55M extension with Rams
headlines.detail: Rodgers, 42, returns to Pittsburgh for his last year. Seahawks OTAs underway as defending Super Bowl LX champions.

headlines.headline: 2026 transfer portal window closes; Leavitt to LSU, Moore to Colorado headline moves
headlines.detail: QB Sam Leavitt commits to Lane Kiffin's LSU. Deion Sanders lands WR DeAndre Moore Jr. at Colorado. Notre Dame gets Quincy Porter from Ohio State.
